en.dr-ali-peiravi: 28-80 Muhammad ibn Al-Hassan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Waleed - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Al-Hussein ibn Al-Hassan ibn Aban quoted on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Sa’eed, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Bint Elias that he had heard Al-Ridha (s) say,

“The Prophet of God (s) damned whoever causes an affliction or hides someone who has done so.” Al-Hassan ibn Bint Elias asked, “What is meant by causing an affliction here?” The Imam (s) replied, “Killing.”
